name: AlertDialog
description: A confirmation dialog for destructive or irreversible actions that scales in over a blurred backdrop with Cancel focused by default. Clicking the backdrop does not dismiss it; the panel gives a gentle pulse instead, so a decision is always explicit.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA alertdialog pattern: role="alertdialog" with aria-modal, aria-labelledby (title) and aria-describedby (description) so the consequence is announced. Focus moves to the Cancel button (the least destructive action) on open, Tab/Shift+Tab are trapped inside, Escape cancels, and focus returns to the trigger on close. Backdrop clicks never confirm or dismiss; they refocus Cancel. Body scroll is locked while open. The warning icon is decorative. Under prefers-reduced-motion the panel only fades and the pulse is disabled.

defaultProps.title: Are you absolutely sure?
defaultProps.description: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your account and remove your data from our servers.
